list_messages_by_user: list messages between you and a specific user by providing their user_id
list_messages_after_date: list messages created after a given datetime timestamp within the last 30 days
list_unread_messages: list all unread messages you have received without marking them as read
send_message_to_participant: send a message to a study participant or another researcher by study_id and recipient_id
review_Messages_class: review the Messages class API endpoints and class methods for listing and sending messages
